card.fires_on: Single digits or short pieces inside identifiers, such as mouse strain names, karyotypes, gene alleles and trial names, and sometimes inside a drug name. It fires on the piece after the start of the label, not on the first character.

modes.label: Digits in genetic codes
modes.description: A digit inside a strain name, karyotype or HLA allele.

modes.label: Pieces of trial or drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of a trial acronym or a drug name.

modes.label: Digit in study duration
modes.description: A digit at the start of a follow-up time.
